# pai audit

Find out where tokens are being spent

```
pai audit <command>
```

Read-only reports on what your setup costs in tokens: memory files, hooks, sessions, helper sessions, background service, skills, MCP servers.

```sh
pai audit tokens
pai audit tokens session
pai audit tokens mcp
```

See also: `pai skill telemetry`

### pai audit tokens

Token-waste report (all checks, or pick one below)

```
pai audit tokens [command] [options]
```

Runs every check and prints one combined report with findings ranked by severity. Run one check on its own with a sub-command: files, hooks, session, spawn, daemon, env, schedule, skills, subagents, mcp, ladder.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--record DIR` | string | — | Also write a dated, numbered Markdown and JSON snapshot into DIR |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens
pai audit tokens --json
pai audit tokens --record ./audits
```

See also: `pai audit tokens mcp`

#### pai audit tokens files

Token count per memory file

```
pai audit tokens files [PATHS...] [options]
```

Counts tokens of the CLAUDE.md chain, core skill, rule files and auto-memory, or of the files you name.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATHS...` | no | Files to count (default: the standard memory set) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens files
pai audit tokens files ./CLAUDE.md --json
```

See also: `pai audit tokens`

#### pai audit tokens session

Token split for one session transcript

```
pai audit tokens session [PATH] [options]
```

Shows cache, input and output tokens of a session (default: the newest).

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | no | Session transcript file (default: newest under ~/.claude/projects) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ctx-threshold N` | number | — | Override the compaction trigger (default: derived from the session itself) |
| `--history N` | string | — | List the first-turn context of the newest N sessions of this project (try 20) |
| `--turn N` | number | — | Explain where API call N's context growth came from |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens session
pai audit tokens session --history 20
pai audit tokens session --turn 12
```

See also: `pai audit tokens`

#### pai audit tokens spawn

Helper-session overhead: subagents vs workers

```
pai audit tokens spawn [options]
```

Compares the start-up cost of in-session subagents with pai workers.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-n, --n COUNT` | number | — | How many of the newest logs per group to read (default 10) |
| `--detail` | flag | — | One row per log |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens spawn
pai audit tokens spawn -n 20 --detail
```

See also: `pai audit tokens`

#### pai audit tokens mcp

MCP servers: configured, pinned, loaded, used

```
pai audit tokens mcp [options]
```

Compares what is configured, what is pinned, what a live session loaded and what was used in the last 30 days.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--connect` | flag | — | Actually connect to every stdio server to count its tools (has side effects) |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens mcp
pai audit tokens mcp --connect
```

See also: `pai audit tokens`

#### pai audit tokens usage

Exact token totals per model for one session transcript

```
pai audit tokens usage TRANSCRIPT [options]
```

Sums a Claude Code session transcript's assistant usage (each message id once, its final usage) per model. This is the tier-0 side of the A/B comparison: the top orchestrator session; its workers are `pai worker usage`.

Prices (USD per million tokens, matched on the model name):
  opus    input $5/M, output $25/M
  sonnet  input $3/M, output $15/M
  haiku   input $1/M, output $5/M
  cache read 0.1x input, cache write 5m 1.25x, cache write 1h 2x

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TRANSCRIPT` | yes | Session transcript .jsonl |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens usage ~/.claude/projects/-my-proj/SESSION.jsonl
pai audit tokens usage ./session.jsonl --json
```

See also: `pai worker usage`, `pai audit tokens session`

#### pai audit tokens ladder

LIVE: first-turn context per configuration step

```
pai audit tokens ladder [options]
```

Starts real headless claude calls at growing configurations and measures the first-turn context. Refuses without --live because it costs money.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--live` | flag | — | Really start claude -p (billed); required |
| `--model ID` | string | — | Model to probe with (default haiku) |
| `--mcp-config PATH` | string | — | MCP config for the third step (default: newest *.mcp.json in the workers log folder) |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai audit tokens ladder
pai audit tokens ladder --live --model haiku
```

See also: `pai audit tokens`
